newsitem.title: USA: Premark Int'l posts solid Q1 oper net gain.
newsitem.headline: Premark Int'l posts solid Q1 oper net gain.

text.p: Premark International Inc said Friday record revenues from its operating divisions helped income from continuing operations for the first quarter ended March 29 reach record levels.

The company reported operating income of $20.8 million, or $0.32 a share, versus $11.8 million, or $0.19, a year ago. Sales in the period rose three percent to a record $546 million from $528 million, the company said.

Premark also said it acquired certain assets and liabilities of Eurocatering SpA, a maker of warewash equipment, for about $20 million in cash and the assumption of $18 million of debt. The deal is expected to be modestly accretive in 1997, Premark said.
Premark markets premium products in more than 100 nations.
Its shares closed up 2-3/8 Friday at 24.
